svg.text: - top 32 pkt each pay ONE ACT, but tFAW caps issue at 4/window -> 8 waves -> ~8*tFAW ~ 256 CK to open all 32 banks. Req WAITS on ACT budget, not data.
- bottom 32 pkt = same 32 banks, next col, row STILL OPEN -> straight CAS hits, zero ACT. Only the first row-open costs ACTs.
- opened banks stream CAS at tCCD_S=8 (diff-BG pack) and overlap the next wave's ACTs. Heat = how late a bank gets its ACT slot.
One 4KB linear read spreads across CH0/RANK0's 32 banks (8 BG x 4 bank); first-touch cols MISS/ACT, throttled 4 per tFAW (heat waves); next col to the same open rows = all HIT. tFAW is the gate.
